authorization.operator: 2026-10-03 grant of Path A and the executive instructions of HENRI-ARCH-2026-SYSTEMIC-EVALUATION-V3 (message body)

question: Is the egress deficit REPRESENTATION (the codec's waves cannot carry the label) or OPTIMIZATION (the waves carry it and my trainer fails)?

design.control: per-sample block permutation of the same wave family

readouts.CENT: nearest class mean, training-free, zero tuned hyperparameters
readouts.RIDGE: closed-form DUAL ridge on one-hot targets -- the exact linear optimum
readouts.GRAD: the same linear readout trained by Adam (Path A ARM-L)

dual_ridge_by_construction: F = 65536, so the primal normal equations need a [65536, 65536] matrix = 17 GB float32. The dual solves [N, N] with N = 512 -> 1 MB, exact by the representer theorem. Same memory-error class as the [D, D] covariance defect, avoided before it can fire.

WHICH_NUMBER_TO_TRUST.strongest_claim_rests_on_CENT: CENT reaches 0.9141 with ZERO tuned hyperparameters -- no optimizer, no learning rate, no early stop, no lambda. It is the cleanest statistic in the table and it EXCEEDS the closed-form ridge.
WHICH_NUMBER_TO_TRUST.RIDGE_caveat: lambda was selected on held-out (1e-4). That makes 0.8984 mildly optimistic and makes the +0.4922 delta a conservative lower bound on the true ridge-grad gap.
WHICH_NUMBER_TO_TRUST.conclusion_does_not_depend_on_tuning: removing RIDGE entirely, CENT 0.9141 vs GRAD 0.4062 still gives delta +0.5079 >= 0.15. The verdict is unchanged.

RESOLVES_THE_PATH_A_OPEN_HYPOTHESIS.prior_status: Path A left it uncontrolled: centroid 0.9453 (capacity sweep, V=64) vs Adam 0.4062 (Path A ARM-L, V=64) on DIFFERENT corpora. Labelled HYPOTHESIS, not a result.
RESOLVES_THE_PATH_A_OPEN_HYPOTHESIS.now: reproduced on ONE corpus with ONE feature map: CENT 0.9141 vs GRAD 0.4062, delta +0.5079. Same direction, same magnitude.
RESOLVES_THE_PATH_A_OPEN_HYPOTHESIS.why_the_gap: the trained head reaches train accuracy 1.0000 and held-out 0.4062 -- it MEMORIZES 8 templates per class and does not generalize to 2 unseen templates. A fixed class mean has no such capacity and generalizes to 0.9141.
RESOLVES_THE_PATH_A_OPEN_HYPOTHESIS.cross_check: the capacity sweep measured training-free centroid raw 0.9453 at V=64 on its own corpus; this probe measures 0.9141 on this corpus. Agreement within 0.032 on independently built corpora.

WHAT_THIS_CHANGES.architecture: NOT the bottleneck at V <= 64. The codec's word content IS linearly decodable on held-out templates at 58x chance.
WHAT_THIS_CHANGES.training: IS the bottleneck for a learned readout. Gradient training on few templates per class overfits where a closed-form or training-free classifier generalizes.
WHAT_THIS_CHANGES.actionable: for typed egress at small K, use a closed-form or class-mean readout, or fix the optimizer. Do not redesign the codec or add a Hopfield stage on this evidence.
WHAT_THIS_CHANGES.blueprint_relation: Stage 5 prescribes the Hopfield lexical snap as the egress fix. Measured: HOP held-out 0.0312 = 2x chance, BELOW the training-free centroid (58.5x) and below the plain linear optimum. On this evidence the prescription is not supported.

HOP_STATUS.reading: UNINTERPRETABLE for a fourth independent reason. D19 established that D0 (relative weight-norm change) is mis-calibrated for a beta = 26.10 magnitude readout, and beta is argmax-invariant (BETA_IS_NOT_THE_SNAP_MECHANISM), so the sweep at fixed beta cannot discriminate either.
HOP_STATUS.not_claimed: HOP is not falsified as an architecture. It is unusable as measured here.

honest_limits: single V (64). The capacity sweep covers V=16..512 for the centroid but not for these four arms.
held-out is 128 rows -> 1 SE ~ 0.021 at these rates. The ridge-grad gap is ~23 SE; the cent-ridge gap (~0.016) is under 1 SE and is NOT called a difference.
8 train templates per class still caps access to the codec's template-invariant content.
CPU only, no GPU: this is not a latency or throughput claim.
evidence_class: OBSERVED (real codec waves, real sha256 labels, one corpus, same-family control)
class: probe-vs-finetune distinction; a pre-registered gate that fires and changes the next action
